additional_context: FHIR-3088's older wording was superseded; FHIR-3768, FHIR-5140/FHIR-5141, and FHIR-13320 reinforce the current case-sensitive 64-character semantics.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml:304 to describe upper/lower-case ASCII ids, the 64-character limit, case-sensitive ids, and lowercase UUIDs; left the already-correct regex unchanged.
